steps.en: Approve a Linux build, kernel permissions and a test-data capture scope
steps.zh: 批准 Linux 构建、内核权限和测试数据捕获范围
在录制模式下启动应用

steps.en: Exercise representative API calls against real dependencies
steps.zh: 向真实依赖发送有代表性的 API 调用

steps.en: Save API requests, expected responses and dependency mocks
steps.zh: 保存 API 请求、预期响应和依赖桩

steps.en: Review fixtures and replay with non-JSON body comparison enabled
steps.zh: 审核夹具，开启非 JSON 正文比较后重放

steps.en: Replay requests, serve saved dependency replies and report response differences
steps.zh: 重放请求、返回保存的依赖响应并报告差异

value.en: Regression checks reuse observed dependency replies instead of hand-authoring every mock
value.zh: 回归检查复用观察到的依赖响应，不再逐项手写所有桩
